title: Welcome to Skrongle
summary: What Skrongle is, the five ways to learn and who can do what.
focus: The shape of the app and who can do what
content:
## What Skrongle is

Skrongle teaches from courses. A course is a set of lessons. You open a course, pick a way to learn and go.

Every way to learn uses the same lessons. What you do in one way counts in the others.

## Five ways to learn

- **Sprint mode**: short sessions for a phone, about five minutes.
- **Study mode**: read each lesson and test yourself.
- **Play mode**: games and flashcards.
- **Guide**: one lesson at a time, in small steps.
- **AI tutoring**: a chat with a tutor. It needs an AI key, which the owner adds (see the AI unit).

Courses, Sprint mode, Study mode, Play mode and the Guide all work without any AI key.

## Who can do what

Every account can learn, make its own courses and share them.

One account is the **owner**. This is the person who runs the box Skrongle lives on. The word *Owner* shows under the owner's name on the profile page. Only the owner adds AI keys, hides the AI features and manages the other accounts.

A Skrongle mini holds at most 8 accounts.

one short piece of a course, with text and questions

quiz.prompt: What is a course in Skrongle?
quiz.explanation: A course is a set of lessons. Each lesson has text, words and questions.
hints: Think about what you open from the course list.

quiz.prompt: Something you pass in Sprint mode also counts when you open Study mode.
quiz.explanation: All the ways to learn share the same lessons and the same progress.
hints: Every way to learn uses the same lessons.

quiz.prompt: Which way to learn needs an AI key?
quiz.explanation: The tutor is a chat with an AI, so it needs a key. The other ways to learn work without one.
hints: Only one way to learn talks to an AI provider.

quiz.prompt: Who adds AI keys to the box?
options: The person who made the course
quiz.explanation: Only the owner adds AI keys. They serve every account.
hints: One account has more power than the rest.

quiz.prompt: At most how many accounts can a Skrongle mini hold?
quiz.explanation: A Skrongle mini holds at most 8 accounts.
hints: It is a small number, less than ten.

sorts.title: Who can do it?

items.text: Hide the AI features for everyone

sorts.why: Learning, making and sharing are for everyone. Keys and the AI switch belong to the owner.
